method.bars: broker get_equity_historicals interval=day bounds=regular adjustment_type=split (~14 months). After the 2:00 PM MT close, if broker has not yet published today's daily bar, a today bar is SYNTHESIZED: open/high/low from get_equity_fundamentals (bounds=regular) or today's 5-min bars, close = get_equity_quotes last_trade_price (official regular-session last), volume = best source (see volume). Per-ticker last_daily_close_source says which. The synthesized bar is replaced by broker's own bar on the next run once published.
method.bias: bullish if SMA20>SMA50>SMA200 AND MACD line>signal AND RSI14>50; bearish if SMA20<SMA50<SMA200 AND MACD line<signal AND RSI14<50; else neutral.
method.crypto: broker connector has get_crypto_quotes but no crypto historicals tool. Crypto block = live quote only; indicator fields null with note 'no broker crypto history'.
method.macd: MACD(12,26,9): EMA12-EMA26 line, 9-period EMA signal, hist=line-signal. Cross state from last two hist signs.
method.near_trigger: True when abs(price/level-1) <= 1% for nearest resistance OR a defined trigger (NU 15.84).
method.price: last = get_equity_quotes last_trade_price; as_of = venue_last_trade_time converted to America/Denver ISO offset. last_daily_close/_date = previous completed session (before today), so last/last_daily_close-1 = today's change. indicator_bar_date = date of the newest daily bar used for indicators (today after the close).
method.rsi: Wilder RSI14 and RSI2 on daily closes (same Wilder seed as /workspace/data/backtest/backtest_rules.py).
method.rule1: signal when last_price > SMA200 AND RSI2 < 10; else none. Uses live last vs daily SMA200/RSI2.
method.sma: SMA20/50/200 = simple mean of last N completed daily closes (interpolated bars dropped). During the session the live last is NOT in the SMA window; after the close today's bar (published or synthesized) is included.
method.support_resistance: Nearest support/resistance from swing highs/lows over ~6 months (~126 sessions). A swing high is a bar high strictly above the 2 bars on each side; swing low is the mirror. Resistance = nearest swing high strictly above last price (else highest high in window). Support = nearest swing low strictly below last price (else lowest low in window).
method.today_bar: broker had not published the 2026-10-12 daily bar at build time; synthesized today bars appended for: AAOI, ALAB, APLD, ARM, AVGO, BE, CIEN, COHR, CRDO, CRWV, CVNA, DELL, IREN, LITE, MRVL, NBIS, NVT, NVTS, ON, RGTI, RKLB, SKHY, SLS, SMCI, SOXL, VSAT, WOLF. Indicators include today's close.
method.volume: today = best available source, in order: (1) broker published daily bar for today; (2) get_equity_fundamentals bounds=regular 'volume' with market_date == today (consolidated session volume, matches daily bars/scanner); (3) sum of today's regular-session 5-min bars (PARTIAL feed: on 2026-10-07 the 5-min sum was only ~40-61% of the published daily volume, so this ratio is understated). volume.source names the one used. avg20 = mean volume of the 20 completed daily bars before today. ratio = today/avg20.

method.bias: bullish if SMA20>SMA50>SMA200 AND MACD line>signal AND RSI14>50; bearish if SMA20<SMA50<SMA200 AND MACD line<signal AND RSI14<50; else neutral.
method.rule1: signal when last_price > SMA200 AND RSI2 < 10; else none. Uses live last vs daily SMA200/RSI2.
method.support_resistance: swing highs/lows over last 126 sessions (local extremum vs 2 bars each side); nearest swing above/below last price; else window high/low if still beyond price; else null if live price cleared the window

chart.how: From levels.json. Starts at 0.8. Trend: bias, price vs 50-day and price vs 200-day each +0.4 when they agree with the trade's direction, -0.4 when they disagree, 0 when neutral. Stretch: -1 for a put with RSI(2) < 5 or a call with RSI(2) > 95. Room: +0.5 when the target is farther from the trigger than the exit is. Volume: +0.5 when the volume ratio is ≥ 1.0. Kept within 0-3. Distance to trigger and time decay aren't scored.
chart.label: Chart

news.how: From x_momentum.json. +2 when the tone matches the trade and news_backed is true. 0 when the tone matches but it's X only (news_backed false), when neutral, or when there's no row. -2 when the tone fights the trade. A read older than 18 hours counts 0.
news.label: News

options.how: Options Scout's opt_score_pts from ideas_board.json, used as-is (0-2). It already includes reward/risk at the target, liquidity, breakeven distance and days to expiry, so reward/risk isn't counted anywhere else.
options.label: Options

risk.how: Points for a smaller loss at the stop measured against the account (Risk Checker's grade). Exact account figures are hidden in the public view.
risk.label: Risk

rubric.label: Setup score, not a win rate. No scored trades yet.
rubric.missing_rule: A part with no data scores its neutral value and is listed as missing.
rubric.owner: Desk-agreed rubric (Risk 3 + Chart 3 + Options 2 + News 2 = 10). Risk Checker can tune the numbers; the page and score_setups.js both read this file.

scale.rounding: sum of the four parts, rounded to the nearest whole number, then ceilings, then clamped to 1-10
scale.score_cap: the row's score_cap (Options Scout, e.g. 4 when liquidity fails) is an extra ceiling
